choice.basis: The y-axis is inverted, with 0 at the top and 35 at the bottom, meaning larger numerical values are plotted lower on the page. The marker for 1980 is the lowest point on the chart, corresponding to a y-value of approximately 38, which is the highest value on the scale. The markers for 1976 and 1986 are much higher on the page, corresponding to lower values (approximately 12 and 15, respectively). Therefore, 1980 represents the highest per-barrel cost observed in this screening cycle.
